maml:description.maml:para: Gets Cloudflare DNS records.

Lists DNS records in a zone or gets one DNS record by zone and record identifier. Filter parameters are optional API query inputs. Output objects are typed Cloudflare.PowerShell.CfDnsRecord values and expose DnsRecordId as a PowerShell identity alias for Id; a record does not carry its parent ZoneId.
Parameter set 'Get': Gets one record using both the required ZoneId and DnsRecordId. Supplying only a record object is insufficient because its parent zone is not inferable.
Parameter set 'List': Lists records in the required ZoneId. The shared paginator follows the API page results until an empty page.
Identifies the parent zone and is mandatory for both list and get. It can bind by property name from CfZone.ZoneId, including the ETS alias projected from CfZone.Id.

Identifies one DNS record in the Get parameter set. RecordId is a compatibility alias. A CfDnsRecord object can provide this identity by property name through its ETS DnsRecordId alias, but it cannot provide the parent ZoneId.

maml:description.maml:para: Gets Cloudflare zones.

Lists zones visible to the authenticated account or gets one zone by ZoneId. The list parameters are sent as optional API filters; the projection's generated values and the API's own defaults are not interchangeable. Output objects are typed Cloudflare.PowerShell.CfZone values and expose ZoneId as a PowerShell identity alias for Id.
Parameter set 'Get': Gets one zone by its ZoneId and writes one CfZone object.
Parameter set 'List': Lists zones and writes one CfZone object per result. No ZoneId is required.

Parameter set 'Create': Creates one record with the mandatory ZoneId and typed Record body.

maml:description.maml:para: Removes a Cloudflare DNS record.

Removes one DNS record by its parent ZoneId and DnsRecordId. The operation has no success output and uses high-impact ShouldProcess confirmation; use -WhatIf before a real delete. RecordId is a compatibility alias for DnsRecordId.
Parameter set 'Delete': Deletes one record using both its parent ZoneId and DnsRecordId.
Identifies the parent zone and is mandatory. Supply it explicitly when piping a CfDnsRecord.
Identifies the DNS record to remove. RecordId is an alias. A CfDnsRecord object can provide this resource identity by property name, but it cannot provide the required parent ZoneId.

maml:description.maml:para: Updates a Cloudflare DNS record.

Edits or replaces one DNS record by ZoneId and DnsRecordId. Use exactly one body parameter: -Edit sends a partial PATCH-style body, while -Replace sends a complete PUT-style body. The operation supports high-impact ShouldProcess and -WhatIf.
Parameter set 'Edit': The Edit set sends a partial Hashtable using PATCH semantics. Provide exactly one -Edit body.
Parameter set 'Replace': The default set sends one replacement Hashtable using PUT semantics. Provide exactly one -Replace body.
Identifies the parent zone and is mandatory. Supply it explicitly when piping a CfDnsRecord.
Identifies the DNS record to update. RecordId is an alias. A CfDnsRecord object can provide this resource identity by property name, but it cannot provide the required parent ZoneId.
A Hashtable containing only fields to change. This parameter selects the Edit set and is serialized as a PATCH-style request body.
